analysis:
Examined all 35 primary analyses and all replayed source/metadata. No concrete regression is independently established by the available evidence. Replay contains only 14 of 206 reviewed source units; summaries cannot substitute for omitted implementations.

The central change replaces GLM bracketing hashes with managed-load verification and permits persisted startup registration hashes (changelog.d/glm-startup-single-verification.md:3–4; ProviderLoop+Serve.swift:108). Under A-004, TB-003, T-012/T-027 and T-041, operator-owned records cannot independently prove weight integrity. The analyses describe fresh verification before serving, so forged registration records alone do not establish a serving bypass. Remaining review must trace VerifiedWeightHashStore.swift:58–115, Darkbloom.swift:178–228, GLM5NextManagedLoad.swift:155–182 and ModelLoading.swift:550–624 together: exact loaded-byte verification, mutation checks, aggregate equivalence, persistence timing, and cache/routing consumers.

New JSON/forced-tool acceptance and reasoning replay expand inference behavior. The changelogs conflict about forced-choice refusal; this is documentation drift, not proof of unsafe enforcement. Verify scheduler withholding, parser/schema failure handling, bounded buffering, cancellation and firstWithheldOutputAt deadline/billing semantics across local and coordinator paths (T-007, T-008, T-010, T-056). No supplied change demonstrates weakened encrypted streaming or authenticated cache scoping.

Variable-frame-rate acceptance requires verification of decoder work/frame bounds and protected plaintext custody (T-050). Expanded reclaimable-memory accounting at hardware-support.md:256–262 needs validation against SystemMemory and admission/KV consumers for counter overlap and duplicate credit. Wired-limit guidance is documented as operator-applied; no automatic privilege escalation is shown. Diagnostic callers still require checking GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice for sensitive error disclosure.

libs/mlx-swift-lm:1 changes the native dependency without its diff. That omission materially prevents validating loader, media, output-control and retirement contracts. Obtain the omitted runtime changes and dependency diff before clearing these uncertainties; unchanged authorization, attestation, token custody and payment implementations were not audited.
